description:
### Initial Checks

- [x] I confirm that I'm using Pydantic V2

### Description

When using either the `from_attributes=True` in the model config or as an argument to the `model_validate` function, any ValidationError that is raised from a field validator on a NamedTuple's field does not include the attribute name. Instead, it seems to include the attribute's position within the tuple.

If I instead use `model_validate` and pass a dictionary, the ValidationError from the NamedTuple's field validator contains the attribute's name.

For example:

```
... ExampleModel.model_validate(SomeOtherInput(), from_attributes=True)
...
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<python-input-0>", line 16, in <module>
    ExampleModel.model_validate(SomeOtherInput(), from_attributes=True)
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/rccausey/.cache/pypoetry/virtualenvs/billing-api--M5yUIBR-py3.13/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pydantic/main.py", line 703, in model_validate
    return cls.__pydantic_validator__.validate_python(
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^
        obj, strict=strict, from_attributes=from_attributes, context=context, by_alias=by_alias, by_name=by_name
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    )
    ^
pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for ExampleModel
tuple_attr.1
  Input should be greater than 0 [type=greater_than, input_value=0, input_type=int]
    For further information visit https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.11/v/greater_than
>>> ExampleModel.model_validate({"tuple_attr": {"alarm_type_id": "alarmtype_asdf", "sequence_number": 0}})
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<python-input-1>", line 1, in <module>
    ExampleModel.model_validate({"tuple_attr": {"alarm_type_id": "alarmtype_asdf", "sequence_number": 0}})
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/rccausey/.cache/pypoetry/virtualenvs/billing-api--M5yUIBR-py3.13/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pydantic/main.py", line 703, in model_validate
    return cls.__pydantic_validator__.validate_python(
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^
        obj, strict=strict, from_attributes=from_attributes, context=context, by_alias=by_alias, by_name=by_name
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    )
    ^
pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for ExampleModel
tuple_attr.sequence_number
  Input should be greater than 0 [type=greater_than, input_value=0, input_type=int]
    For further information visit https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.11/v/greater_than
>>>
```


### Example Code

```Python
from typing import Annotated, NamedTuple

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExampleTuple(NamedTuple):
    alarm_type_id: Annotated[str, Field(pattern=r"^alarmtype_.*$")]
    sequence_number: Annotated[int, Field(gt=0)]

class ExampleModel(BaseModel):
    tuple_attr: ExampleTuple

class SomeOtherInput:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tuple_attr = ExampleTuple(alarm_type_id="alarmtype_JtHRjBKie01iOss0KoUul10RzD9", sequence_number=0)

ExampleModel.model_validate(SomeOtherInput(), from_attributes=True)
```

### Python, Pydantic & OS Version

```Text
             pydantic version: 2.11.3
        pydantic-core version: 2.33.1
          pydantic-core build: profile=release pgo=false
                 install path: /home/rccausey/.cache/pypoetry/virtualenvs/billing-api--M5yUIBR-py3.13/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pydantic
               python version: 3.13.3 (main, May 21 2025, 10:47:46) [GCC 11.4.0]
                     platform: Linux-6.6.87.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2-x86_64-with-glibc2.35
             related packages: typing_extensions-4.12.2
                       commit: unknown
```
